question: The Nehru Rozgar Yojana (NRY) was launched in which Five-Year Plan in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seventh**__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **7th five-year plan **Jawahar Rojgar Yojna was launched.
 
• Jawahar Rozgar Yojana was** launched in 1989 by the Rajiv Gandhi government.**
 
• It was implemented upon the merger of th**e National Rural Employment Programme (NREP) and Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme (RLEGP).**
 
• The Seventh Five Year Plan (1985-1990) also laid impetus on the development of small-scale and food processing industries
 
• The Seventh Five Year Plan also **encouraged 'Social Justice'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**All Five Year Plans:**

 
 

 First Five Year Plan
 1951 to 1956.
 
 

 Second Five Year Plan
 1956 to 1961
 
 

 Third Five Year Plan
 1961 to 1966
 
 

 Plan Holiday
 1966 to 1969
 
 

 Fourth Five Year Plan
 1969 to 1974
 
 

 Fifth Five Year Plan
 1974 to 1979

 **1978-79**
 
 

 Sixth Five Year Plan
 1980 to 1985
 
 

 Seventh Five Year Plan
 1985 to 1990
 
 

 **Annual Plans**
 **1990-91& 1991-92.**
 
 

 Eighth Five Year Plan
 1992 to 1997

 1997 to 2002
 
 

 Tenth Five Year Plan
 2002 to 2007
 
 

 Eleventh Five Year Plan

 Twelfth Five Year Plan
 2012 to 2017
